_meta: Hausa (ha) translations. AI-drafted; a native-speaker pass is still recommended before fielding. Any key left in English still renders in English at runtime via the fallback in i18n/index.js.
welcome.title: Maraba da zuwa Wasan Zuba Jari
welcome.subtitle: Wannan kayan aikin gwajin filin ne na wani bincike da CIMMYT da CDA-BUK ke gudanarwa a Najeriya. Wasa ne na bincike, wanda ake amfani da shi don dalilan bincike kaɗai.
language.title: Zaɓi harshe
enumerator.title: Saitin zama
enumerator.recording: Ba da izinin rikodi (tare da yardar mai shiga)
instructions.title: Yadda wasan ke aiki
instructions.body: Za ka yi wasa na 1 na gwaji da 10 na hakika. A kowane lokaci za ka yanke shawara ko za ka yi amfani da taki a masara, kuma idan haka ne, nawa. Girbinka ya dogara ga ruwan sama; kuɗin da ka samu ya dogara ga ruwan sama da farashin kasuwa. Duka ba a tabbata ba, kuma za a gaya maka damar kowanne kafin kowane lokaci.
decision.confirm.title: Kana tabbata?
decision.confirm.body: Ba za ka iya canza shawararka bayan saka a taki ba.
weather.normal: Ruwan sama na yau da kullum
price.mid: Farashin kasuwa na yau da kullum
summary.title: Takaitawar kaka
finalPayout.title: Jimillar kuɗin da ka samu
survey.title: Tambayoyi kaɗan
completion.title: Na gode
completion.body: Don Allah mayar da kwamfutar hannu ga ma'aikacin filin.
admin.title: Sashin ma'aikacin filin
round.outlookBody: Karanta hasashen ruwan sama da farashin kasuwa, sannan ka yanke shawarar yawan takin da za ka yi amfani da shi.
round.doseTitle: Nawa taki za ka yi amfani da shi?
round.doseBody: Kowace buhu kuɗinta token 1 ne. Kana farawa kakar da token {budget}; duk wanda ba ka kashe ba zai kasance naka.
round.summaryDetail: Dangane da girbin masara da farashin kasuwa, takinka ya dawo da kuɗi {ret} (ka saka {dose}).
round.summaryProfit: Ka samu riba {net} fiye da abin da ka saka.
round.summaryLoss: Ba ka dawo da kuɗin takin da ka saka ba a wannan kakar.
round.summaryEven: Ka dawo da daidai kuɗin takin da ka saka.
round.summaryNoFert: Ba ka sayi taki ba a wannan kakar — ka riƙe dukan kuɗinka.
training.concept.title: Fahimtar yiwuwa da hotuna
training.concept.body1: Ka yi tunanin kakaki goma na noma. A wasu kakaki ruwan sama yana da kyau, a wasu matsakaici ne, a kuma kaɗan ruwan sama ya kasa sai fari ya auku. Za mu iya nuna sau nawa kowane irin kaka yake faruwa ta amfani da hoto kamar haka:
training.concept.body2: Kowane ƙaramin murabba'i kaka ɗaya ce. A wannan hoto, kakaki bakwai cikin goma suna da ruwan sama mai kyau, biyu suna da matsakaici, ɗaya kuma yana da fari. Idan ka ga hoto kamar haka a wasan, yana gaya maka abin da za ka jira a kaka mai zuwa.
training.count.title: Ƙidaya kakaki
training.count.body: Ga ƙarin kakaki goma. Kafin ka danna maɓallin, ka yi ƙoƙarin ƙidaya a kanka: nawa ne ke da ruwan sama mai kyau, nawa matsakaici, nawa fari?
training.count.answer: biyar kyau · uku matsakaici · biyu fari — cikin kakaki goma.
training.check.title: Tambayoyi biyu masu sauri
training.check.body: Amsa dukansu don tabbatar da hotunan suna fili. Amsoshin da ba daidai ba ba za a ƙidaya su ba — ci gaba da ƙoƙari.
training.q.drought: Cikin kakaki goma da aka nuna a nan, nawa ne ke da yiwuwar yin fari?
training.q.priceMode: A cikin waɗannan kakaki goma, wane farashin kasuwa ya fi yiwuwa a lokaci na gaba?
survey.q.usesFertilizer: Kana yawan amfani da taki a masararka?
